name: u3d
description: Universal 3D (ECMA-363) reference library (Intel u3d, GitHub fork DmytroSytnyk/u3d) used by ModelViewer to write the 3D stream embedded in a Save as 3D PDF export. Local overlay port: no upstream vcpkg port exists. Builds the static IDTF converter library plus the four IFX run-time modules that must be shipped next to the application.
